purpose: Part 1/2 of verified cognizance-crystal family 9-record item effect batch 028; capacity/pricing tables remain separately captured and are not paraphrased here.

items/cognizance-crystal-1-point-355.name: Cognizance Crystal, 1 point
items/cognizance-crystal-1-point-355.effectSummary: The crystal stores power points up to its listed maximum. The holder can spend stored points instead of points from their own reserve to manifest a power they know, but cannot combine points from multiple sources or directly transfer stored points into their personal reserve. The crystal can be recharged 1-for-1 by spending the user's own power points as a standard mental action; stored points remain until used. A creature must carry or hold the crystal continuously for at least 10 minutes before using it. A typical crystal has AC 7, 10 hit points, hardness 8, and break DC 16.
